scope: Certified domain: decode calls in which every active expert fits in one M-tile (at most BLOCK_M rows). Calls where an expert needs a second M-tile (the most concentrated routing at T >= 32) are not certified; they are reported as the descriptive SIGMA-D row. Certification covers time as a function of the expert counts only: it does not cover a dependence on which experts are active (Mixtral's published expert-set effect, up to about 2.5 us at R 1). G3-D label, the test of that dependence, is DESCRIPTIVE (addendum 3, owner 2026-10-29 and 2026-11-03): it is reported per model and neither stops the CAL2 reading nor voids a blind model's certification; G3-D shuffle and GD2 void as registered.
